claims.text: First tests for acute CP: pulse oximetry, ECG and CXR.
claims.quote: Most patients should initially have pulse oximetry, ECG, and chest radiographs.

claims.text: POCUS or echocardiogram can help, esp w hemodynamic instability: it shows ventricular dysfun, Rt ventricular P overload, valve dz, pericardial effusion and tamponade.
claims.quote: Sometimes, particularly in patients with hemodynamic instability, either a point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) or a complete echocardiogram can also be useful in further evaluating potential life-threatening causes (2). Echocardiography can be particularly useful in identifying left ventricular or right ventricular dysfunction, evidence of right ventricular pressure overload, valvular pathology, pericardial effusions, and signs of pericardial tamponade.

claims.text: Troponin if Sx suggest ACS or ⍉other cause = clear.
claims.quote: If symptoms suggest an acute coronary syndrome or if no other cause is clear (particularly in patients who are at risk), troponin levels are measured.

claims.text: Serial troponins and serial ECGs for sus ACS, b/c one norm set of biomarkers does ⍉r/o a ♡ cause.
claims.quote: Because a single normal set of cardiac biomarkers does not rule out a cardiac cause, patients whose symptoms suggest an acute coronary syndrome should have serial measurement of the cardiac biomarker troponin and serial ECGs.

claims.text: Compare w prev ECGs: ST-segment chgs can be nonspecific or ← older dz.
claims.quote: Further, ST-segment abnormality on the ECG may be nonspecific or due to antecedent disorders, so comparison with previous ECGs is important.

claims.text: D-dimer when PE = poss and risk = ↓ or intermed.
claims.quote: If a pulmonary embolism (PE) is considered possible, D-dimer testing is done in patients who are at low or intermediate risk.

claims.text: Stress ECG or stress imaging after (−) initial testing = reasonable when sus for CAD = intermed to ↑.
claims.quote: Following up negative initial testing (acutely or within several days) with a stress ECG or a stress imaging test is also reasonable, particularly when there is an intermediate to high clinical suspicion for coronary artery disease

claims.text: Chronic CP: start w a CXR, then test by Sx/S.
claims.quote: In patients with chronic chest pain, immediate threats to life are unlikely. Most clinicians initially obtain a chest radiograph and do other tests based on symptoms and signs.
